steps.message: Delete the newest note in Markor.
Execute: adb shell "date; getprop persist.sys.timezone; pm list packages | grep -i markor"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date; getprop persist.sys.timezone; pm list packages | grep -i markor""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "for d in /sdcard /storage/emulated/0 /sdcard/Documents /storage/emulated/0/Documents; do echo '##' $d; ls -la $d 2>/dev/null | grep -i markor || true; done; for d in /sdcard/Markor /storage/emulated/0/Markor /sdcard/Documents/Markor /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor; do if [ -d $d ]; then echo '##FILES' $d; find $d -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*.md' -o -iname '*.txt' -o -iname '*.todo.txt' -o -iname '*.org' \) -printf '%T@ %p\n' | sort -nr | head -n 10; fi; done"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "for d in /sdcard /storage/emulated/0 /sdcard/Documents /storage/emulated/0/Documents; do echo '##' $d; ls -la $d 2>/dev/null | grep -i markor || true; done; for d in /sdcard/Markor /storage/emulated/0/Markor /sdcard/Documents/Markor /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor; do if [ -d $d ]; then echo '##FILES' $d; find $d -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -iname '*.md' -o -iname '*.txt' -o -iname '*.todo.txt' -o -iname '*.org' \) -printf '%T@ %p\n' | sort -nr | head -n 10; fi; done""
